<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 182.073165. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the formula C₁₃H₁₀O (13 C = 156 Da, 10 H ≈ 10.078 Da, 1 O ≈ 15.995 Da → total ≈ 182.073 Da). The isotopic pattern (≈14 % M+1) is consistent with ~13 carbons. Hence the molecular formula of the compound is C13H10O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
